opportunities.point: The company remains on track to achieve its FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company aims to achieve an operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "But our plan is that, overall, we are now targeting to have operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%, that we have also provided in our IP as well." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Future capacity expansion after 2028 is expected to require a capex close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores under a leased model.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that customers are consolidating their supplier base and prefer to work with fewer, larger, established, and compliant manufacturers.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Importantly, our customers are working to consolidate their supplier base. They want to work with fewer larger, established, well-capitalized, professionally run and compliant jewelry manufacturers." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company observed a shift in consumer preferences towards lower karatage jewelry as youngsters want to buy lower karatage at a budget.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat. So, 100% there is a shift and generations out change also, because youngsters want to buy lower..." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East's largest retail chains in record time.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "• Global Market Penetration: Our merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East’s largest retail chains in record time—a feat notable because the typical sales cycle for such clients is considerably longer." (concall ppt - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Current capacity utilization is close to 55% to 57% or around 60%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that if no interested buyer is finalized for the land monetization within 20 to 30 days, the promoters will purchase it.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase. But we intend not to be a related party transaction, that's why we have stretched one or two months." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows." (concall ppt - 2026-11-01) [FY27]
